facts.material: polycarbonate enclosure with lithium-polymer battery and electronics
facts.function: powers the implanted glucose sensor and wirelessly transmits glucose data to a mobile app
facts.form: reusable external transmitter, imported separately from sensors
facts.end_use: component of Eversense365 continuous glucose monitoring system for diabetes

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9027 covers instruments for physical or chemical analysis; chapter 90 note 2(b) places parts and accessories suitable solely or principally for a particular machine or instrument in the same heading
GRI 6: 9027.90 parts and accessories, of electrical instruments, of 9027.80-type instruments, other (9027.90.56.95)

rejected_alternatives.reason: wireless transmission apparatus; it is solely a component of a glucose monitoring system, so chapter 90 note 2(b) governs
complete CGM system; the transmitter is imported alone
medical instruments; glucose measurement is classed in 9027 per CGM rulings

classification.rationale: N354553 (in force) treated a CGM sensor as a part of the CGM system under chapter 90 note 2(b) and classed it in 9027.90.56.95. The transmitter, usable only with the Eversense sensor, is likewise a part of the system.
